warmUp.note: If you want: a short activity to start.
warmUp.prompt: Look at these things: a phone · a map · a robot · a picture · a book · a video. Which ones can use AI? Choose three and tell your partner.

ui.lessonGoal: Ask and answer simple questions about you and your life.
ui.levelTip: Choose three stations. First answer one question together: What is AI? Short answers are OK.

presentation.introduction: AI is in our phones, schools and jobs. What is good about it? What is a problem? Talk about it with a partner.
presentation.privacyNotice: You can invent examples. Don’t give passwords, private messages, photos or personal information to an AI tool.
quickStart: Give a reason or an example.
Need more? Open the next task.
